headline: Dress Yourself Well
body: We created Pact because we believe what you put closest to your skin, day and night, is essential to your wellbeing. And because what touches your skin should feel as good as it looks. Gentle-on-skin certified organic essentials, free from toxic dyes, harsh chemicals or PFAS.

headline: Our Sustainability Story
body: We think you should know that not all organic is created equal. A lot of brands say organic. We go further, because real organic should always come with real standards that protect your skin, the people who make your clothes, and the planet.

headline: Our Standards
body: Every garment we make is certified organic. That means oversight across the entire supply chain, not just the fiber itself. We don't claim perfection. We commit to progress.

headline: Soft Layers for Every Kind of Day.
body: Pact uses Sustainable Materials, Ethical Manufacturing, and is Climate Friendly and Carbon Neutral. By choosing Organic Cotton, we can create Non-Toxic Clothing that uses 81% less water and 62% less energy.
